svg.title: The €20 note and three meanings of market efficiency
svg.desc: A photograph of a twenty-euro note left on the ground points to three separate claims: rapid information incorporation, no free lunch after risk and costs, and prices equal fundamental value. The first two claims do not imply the third.
svg.text: The €20 note: three different efficiency claims
Finding a reward is not the same as proving that prices are always right.
A €20 NOTE STILL ON THE GROUND
Finding it required someone to notice,
A specified signal can enter price
A public rule does not reliably earn
abnormal return after risk and costs.
The first two claims do not automatically establish the third.
An opportunity may exist because discovering and exploiting it consumes attention, information, capital, and risk-bearing capacity.
